Hi there! Sharing a notebook in Lumen is easy: open the notebook you want to share, click the Share button (or the three-dot menu next to the notebook name and choose Share), then enter the email addresses of the people you'd like to invite or copy a share link. You can choose whether collaborators can view or edit. Let us know if you run into any trouble or need help with permissions!

Hi there! You can update your display name in Settings > Profile > Display Name. Enter your new name and click Save. Your new name should appear next to new comments right away. If older comments still show your old nickname, try refreshing the page or signing out and back in, since cached names can take a little while to update. If it still shows the old nickname after that, let us know and we'll take a closer look. Thanks for using Lumen!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out and sorry about the broken images. Unfortunately, there isn't a setting to re-link attachments after an import, so the most reliable fix is to re-import. Before you do, please check that you exported from Evernote as an .enex file with attachments included and that the file wasn't altered or split. Then delete the affected imported notes (or the import folder) to avoid duplicates and import the .enex again. If the images are still broken after a fresh import, please send us the .enex file size, your Lumen app version and a screenshot of one affected note, and we'll look into it further as a possible bug.

Hi there, sorry about the annoying red underline! You can stop it by adding 'Lumen' to your custom dictionary: right-click (or long-press on mobile) the underlined word and choose 'Add to dictionary'. After that it won't be flagged again. If you'd rather turn spellcheck off entirely, go to Settings > Editor > Spellcheck and toggle it off. If the underline keeps showing up after adding the word, let us know which device and browser or app version you're using and we'll dig in further.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! To turn on offline mode, open Settings, go to Sync & Offline, and toggle on Offline Access. You can then mark individual notebooks as 'Available offline' so they download to your device. Shared notebooks should generally be eligible too: open the shared notebook, tap the notebook menu, and choose 'Make available offline.' Edits you make offline will sync automatically when you reconnect, though if a teammate edits the same note at the same time you may be asked to resolve a conflict. As for storage on the Plus plan, I want to make sure I give you accurate numbers, so please check the current figure on our Pricing page or under Settings > Billing > Plan details, or reply here and a team member will confirm it for you. Let us know if you have any other questions!

Hi there! Thanks for reaching out. I'd be happy to help you set up separate work and personal accounts on one phone. Many people use Lumen this way. Because I can't confirm from here whether multi-account switching is available in your app version, here's the safest approach: open Settings > Account and look for an 'Add account' or 'Switch account' option. If you don't see it, make sure your app is updated to the latest version. If it's still unavailable, let us know your phone model and app version and we'll dig in further. Each account needs its own email address, and notes are kept separate between accounts. Let us know if you run into any trouble!
